versions.changelog:
- Added metadata fields: version, author, and trigger phrases to SKILL.md.
- No logic or functionality changes; documentation only.
- Improves discoverability and automation via trigger keyword list.

- Initial release with lossless FBX to GLB conversion using Assimp engine.
- Provides both command-line (Node.js + assimpjs) and web version (HTML + WASM with 3D preview).
- CLI supports batch conversion, automatic texture/material/animation/skinning retention, and overwrite options.
- Web version includes drag-and-drop upload, instant preview, and one-click GLB download; easy deployment to static hosts and GitHub Pages.
- Detailed troubleshooting and deployment instructions included.
